entries.title: Job 25:1
segments: ¶Then Bildad the Shuhite made answer and said,

entries.title: Job 25:2
segments: Rule and power are his; he makes peace in his high places.

entries.title: Job 25:3
segments: Is it possible for his armies to be numbered? and on whom is not his light shining?

entries.title: Job 25:4
segments: How then is it possible for man to be upright before God? or how may he be clean who is a son of woman?

entries.title: Job 25:5
segments: See, even the moon is not bright, and the stars are not clean in his eyes:

entries.title: Job 25:6
segments: How much less man who is an insect, and the son of man who is a worm!
